statements.purpose: create the run's Activity (one per externalRunSystem + runId)
statements.cypher:
CREATE (act:`Activity`:`Occurrence` {uid: $uid})
SET act += $aProps, act.id = $id, act.privacyClass = $privacyClass, act.lastWriterRunId = $runId, act.createdAt = datetime.transaction(), act.updatedAt = datetime.transaction(), act.`startedAt` = datetime($aDt.`startedAt`)
RETURN act.uid AS uid

MATCH (act:Activity {uid: $activityUid})
CREATE (ag:`Agent`:`Entity` {uid: $uid})
SET ag += $gProps, ag.id = $id, ag.privacyClass = 'PUBLIC', ag.lastWriterRunId = $runId, ag.createdAt = datetime.transaction(), ag.updatedAt = datetime.transaction()
CREATE (ag)-[:WAS_GENERATED_BY]->(act)
RETURN ag.uid AS uid

statements.purpose: link the Activity to the executor Agent
statements.cypher: MATCH (act:Activity {uid: $activityUid}) MATCH (ag:Agent {uid: $agentUid}) CREATE (act)-[:WAS_ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(ag) RETURN act.uid AS uid

MATCH (act:Activity {uid: $activityUid})
CREATE (n:`Source`:`Entity` {uid: $uid})
SET n += $pProps, n.id = $id, n.privacyClass = $privacyClass, n.lastWriterRunId = $runId, n.createdAt = datetime.transaction(), n.updatedAt = datetime.transaction()
CREATE (n)-[:WAS_GENERATED_BY]->(act)
RETURN n.uid AS uid

MATCH (act:Activity {uid: $activityUid})
CREATE (n:`SourceSnapshot`:`InformationArtifact` {uid: $uid})
SET n += $pProps, n.id = $id, n.privacyClass = $privacyClass, n.lastWriterRunId = $runId, n.createdAt = datetime.transaction(), n.updatedAt = datetime.transaction(), n.`observedAt` = datetime($pDt.`observedAt`), n.`retrievedAt` = datetime($pDt.`retrievedAt`)
CREATE (n)-[:WAS_GENERATED_BY]->(act)
RETURN n.uid AS uid
MATCH (s:Source {uid: $sourceUid}) MATCH (snap:SourceSnapshot {uid: $snapshotUid}) CREATE (s)-[r:HAS_SNAPSHOT]->(snap) SET r.lastWriterRunId = $runId RETURN s.uid AS uid

RETURN n.uid AS uid
MATCH (snap:SourceSnapshot {uid: $snapshotUid}) MATCH (l:SourceLocator {uid: $uid}) CREATE (snap)-[r:HAS_LOCATOR]->(l) SET r.lastWriterRunId = $runId RETURN l.uid AS uid

MATCH (act:Activity {uid: $activityUid}) MATCH (s:`Organization` {uid: $subjectUid}) MATCH (w:`Organization` {uid: $asserterUid})
MATCH (o:`Product` {uid: $objectUid})
CREATE (x:Assertion {uid: $uid})
SET x += $pProps, x.id = $id, x.privacyClass = $privacyClass, x.lastWriterRunId = $runId, x.recordedAt = datetime.transaction(), x.createdAt = datetime.transaction(), x.updatedAt = datetime.transaction(), x.`validObservedAt` = datetime($pDt.`validObservedAt`)
CREATE (x)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(s) CREATE (x)-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(w) CREATE (x)-[:WAS_GENERATED_BY]->(act)
CREATE (x)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(o)
WITH x
UNWIND $evidence AS ev
MATCH (l:SourceLocator {uid: ev.uid})
CREATE (x)-[e:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(l) SET e.role = ev.role, e.origin = 'DECLARED', e.expectedSelectedContentDigest = ev.esc, e.lastWriterRunId = $runId
RETURN x.uid AS uid
MATCH (a:`Product` {uid: $fromUid}) MATCH (b:`ProductVariant` {uid: $toUid}) CREATE (a)-[r:`HAS_VARIANT`]->(b) SET r += $props, r.lastWriterRunId = $runId RETURN type(r) AS type
MATCH (a:`ProductVariant` {uid: $fromUid}) MATCH (b:`Package` {uid: $toUid}) CREATE (a)-[r:`HAS_PACKAGE`]->(b) SET r += $props, r.lastWriterRunId = $runId RETURN type(r) AS type

MATCH (act:Activity {uid: $activityUid}) MATCH (s:`Package` {uid: $subjectUid}) MATCH (w:`Organization` {uid: $asserterUid})

CREATE (x:Assertion {uid: $uid})

CREATE (x)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(s) CREATE (x)-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(w) CREATE (x)-[:WAS_GENERATED_BY]->(act)
CREATE (x)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(o)
WITH x
UNWIND $evidence AS ev
MATCH (l:SourceLocator {uid: ev.uid})
CREATE (x)-[e:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(l) SET e.role = ev.role, e.origin = 'DECLARED', e.expectedSelectedContentDigest = ev.esc, e.lastWriterRunId = $runId
RETURN x.uid AS uid

MATCH (a:`Package` {uid: $fromUid}) MATCH (b:`LabelVersion` {uid: $toUid})
CREATE (a)-[r:`HAS_LABEL_VERSION` {relationshipUid: $relUid}]->(b)
SET r += $edgeProps, r.assertionUid = $assertionUid, r.recordedFrom = datetime.transaction(), r.lastWriterRunId = $runId, r.validFrom = CASE WHEN $validFrom IS NULL THEN null ELSE datetime($validFrom) END, r.validTo = CASE WHEN $validTo IS NULL THEN null ELSE datetime($validTo) END, r.validFromPrecision = $validFromPrecision, r.validToPrecision = $validToPrecision, r.validFromBasis = $validFromBasis, r.validToBasis = $validToBasis
RETURN r.relationshipUid AS uid

MATCH (act:Activity {uid: $activityUid}) MATCH (s:`LabelVersion` {uid: $subjectUid}) MATCH (w:`Organization` {uid: $asserterUid})
MATCH (o:`IngredientMaterial` {uid: $objectUid})

SET x += $pProps, x.id = $id, x.privacyClass = $privacyClass, x.lastWriterRunId = $runId, x.recordedAt = datetime.transaction(), x.createdAt = datetime.transaction(), x.updatedAt = datetime.transaction()

MATCH (a:`LabelVersion` {uid: $fromUid}) MATCH (b:`IngredientMaterial` {uid: $toUid})

pProps.name: RESOLUTION PT (Pterostilbene)
pProps.rationale: material identity not resolvable from the label alone

statements.cypher: MATCH (x:`Assessment` {uid: $uid}) UNWIND $targets AS t MATCH (y:`Source` {uid: t}) CREATE (x)-[:ASSESSES]->(y) RETURN y.uid AS uid

MATCH (x:`Assessment` {uid: $uid}) UNWIND $evidence AS ev MATCH (l:SourceLocator {uid: ev.uid})
CREATE (x)-[e:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(l) SET e.role = ev.role, e.origin = coalesce(ev.origin, 'DECLARED'), e.expectedSelectedContentDigest = ev.esc, e.authority = ev.authority, e.independence = ev.independence, e.facet = ev.facet, e.lastWriterRunId = $runId
RETURN l.uid AS uid
